title: confed commands result
description: The `result` of `confed commands --json`: every command with its arguments and flags, read off the command-line definition of the binary that prints it. `confed commands admin perms` gives the one command named, with those below it.

global_flags.description: The flags every command takes, before or after it.

commands.description: Every top-level command, or the one named on the command line.

path.description: How it is typed, from the binary: `confed admin perms copy`.

values.description: The only values it takes, when it takes only some.

commands.description: The commands below it; empty for one that runs something.

value.description: The name of the value it takes; null for a switch, which takes none.

required.description: Whether the command refuses to run without it. A flag one of several of which is needed (`--op` or `--role`) is not marked.

multiple.description: Can be repeated, or takes several values.

values.description: The only values it takes, when it takes only some.

env.description: The environment variable that sets it.
